# rlcdn.com
> RLCDN provides CDN, edge delivery, and related web infrastructure services for accelerating and securing online content.

This site appears to center on CDN and delivery infrastructure. The most useful LLM-facing context is likely around product, support, account, and company resources.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://rlcdn.com/): Overview of RLCDN services, positioning, and primary navigation.
- [About](https://rlcdn.com/about): Company background, mission, and high-level business information.
- [Contact](https://rlcdn.com/contact): Contact channels for sales, support, and general inquiries.
- [Pricing](https://rlcdn.com/pricing): Service plans, pricing structure, or commercial packaging details.
- [Support](https://rlcdn.com/support): Entry point for customer help, troubleshooting, and service assistance.

## Products
- [CDN Services](https://rlcdn.com/cdn): Core content delivery network capabilities and performance features.
- [Edge Delivery](https://rlcdn.com/edge): Edge distribution and request handling across delivery nodes.
- [Streaming](https://rlcdn.com/streaming): Media delivery and streaming-related acceleration features.
- [Security](https://rlcdn.com/security): Security protections for delivered content and web applications.
- [DNS](https://rlcdn.com/dns): DNS-related traffic routing and domain resolution services.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://rlcdn.com/docs): Central documentation index for setup, usage, and administration.
- [Getting Started](https://rlcdn.com/docs/getting-started): Initial onboarding steps for configuring and using RLCDN.
- [Configuration](https://rlcdn.com/docs/configuration): Service configuration options, settings, and operational guidance.
- [Caching](https://rlcdn.com/docs/caching): Cache behavior, invalidation, and optimization documentation.
- [SSL/TLS](https://rlcdn.com/docs/ssl): Certificate management and HTTPS delivery configuration.

## API
- [API Overview](https://rlcdn.com/api): Introduction to available APIs and integration patterns.
- [API Reference](https://rlcdn.com/api/reference): Endpoint-level reference for programmatic service management.
- [Authentication](https://rlcdn.com/api/authentication): API key, token, or credential requirements for access.
- [Zones](https://rlcdn.com/api/zones): Manage delivery zones and related service resources.
- [Purge API](https://rlcdn.com/api/purge): Cache purge and invalidation endpoints for content updates.

## Guides
- [Setup Guide](https://rlcdn.com/guides/setup): Step-by-step instructions for initial service deployment.
- [Custom Domains](https://rlcdn.com/guides/custom-domains): Configure custom hostnames and domain mappings.
- [Origin Configuration](https://rlcdn.com/guides/origin): Connect and tune origin infrastructure for delivery.
- [Performance Optimization](https://rlcdn.com/guides/performance): Improve cache hit ratio, latency, and delivery efficiency.
- [Troubleshooting](https://rlcdn.com/guides/troubleshooting): Diagnose common delivery, configuration, and integration issues.

- [Usage](https://rlcdn.com/usage): Traffic, bandwidth, and service consumption reporting.
- [Status](https://rlcdn.com/status): Service health, incidents, and operational availability updates.
